canonicalSource.idPolicy: Harness-assigned identities, not collaborator IDs recorded in the trace. Same seed42/maybeRandomString 10-character client policy as IdListAlgorithm; one continuous ElementIdGenerator assigns client_sequence (base36) bunches and counters. Every non-anchor bunch is asserted new; a continuation must match both anchor.counter+1 and the generator's next counter. Start empty; never save/reload during replay. Checkpoint save() only observes state.

source.attribution: Editing trace by Martin Kleppmann and the paper's authors, from automerge/automerge-perf. The upstream README states CC-BY-4.0 for the trace. Its concurrent history was flattened to index-based single-character edits; cursor moves are omitted.

upstreamVerification.method: JSON-literal extraction; upstream JavaScript never executed

idModel: Structured client_sequence IDs with independently renamed 10-character clients per document
procedure: Fresh local standalone bound to 127.0.0.1:27186; dbPath and bind options verified before writes
100 independently renamed client dictionaries per layout and snapshot; same document IDs in every collection
Insert in batches of five; validate full SavedIdList round trip for documents 0 and 99
compact every collection; fsync checkpoint; compact every collection again; fsync with lock
Read actual collection .wt file length while locked and verify equality with storageSize; verify configured compressor
Unlock; preserve database files for audit; no existing database or result overwritten
measurement: Physical collection file bytes, including collection allocation/free space; excludes _id indexes and shared database files. No logical BSON size is used.
caveats: One trace, structured client_sequence IDs (not opaque 8-character nanoids)
Independent client strings are 10-character hashes; run shapes and counters repeat across 100 documents
Each snapshot is freshly inserted, not an in-place Mongo update history; these results isolate snapshot representation
Whole-collection file allocation is amortized over 100 documents; one storage build per layout, not statistical repeats
Native runtime representations do not change stored bytes when exporting the same logical F-format

fixtures.description: Final snapshot of the complete original Kleppmann edit stream replayed from empty with no save/load refresh; original operation indices and characters; ElementIds assigned by the benchmark harness
